arabic text: AAI GHAIRATE MARYAM TERA BAAZAR MAIN JAANA
english translation text: O DIGINITY OF MARIUM (A.S), YOU ARE BEING TAKEN THROUGH THE BAZAAR

arabic text: KYUN ZAINABO KULSUM KI CHINTI HAI RIDAA’E\nJAO ARE LOGO MERE BHAI KO BULANA
english translation text: WHY WERE THE VEILS OF BIBI ZAINAB (A.S) AND BIBI UMME KULSOOM (A.S.) SNATCHED,\nO PEOPLE! PLEASE CALL OUR BROTHER TO HELP US

arabic text: JIS GHARPE SALAAMI DIYA KARTETHE PAYAMBER\nTHERO AI MUSALMANO WOHI GHAR NA JALANA
english translation text: THE HOUSE AT WHICH THE PROPHET (PBUH) USED TO SAY SALAM,\nSTOP O MUSLIM! DON’T BURN THAT HOUSE

arabic text: TOO DUKHTARE ZEHRA HAI NAWASI HAI KI\nBAAZAR ME SAR NANGE TERA KHUTBA SUNANA
english translation text: YOU ARE THE DAUGHTER OF ZAHRA (S.A) AND GRAND DAUGHTER OF PROPHET (S.A),\nDESPITE THIS YOU WERE TAKEN TO THE BAZAAR AS CAPTIVES WHERE YOU DELIVERED A SERMON

arabic text: NEEND AAYE BHALA KAISE SAKINA KO ZAMIN PAR\nTOONE HI SIKHAYA ISSE SINE PE SULANA
english translation text: HOW WILL SAKINA (A.S.) SLEEP ON THE FLOOR,\nSHE IS USED TO SLEEPING ON HER FATHER’S CHEST

arabic text: ISLAM PE DO BETON KO QURBAAN KIYA HAI\nKISMAT ME TERI LIKHA HAI YE DAAG UTHANA
english translation text: FOR ISLAM BIBI ZAINAB (S.A.) SACRIFIED BOTH HER SONS,\nSHE WAS DESTINED TO BEAR THIS GREAT LOSS

arabic text: AAI DUKHTARE HAIDER WOH QAYAMAT KI GARITHI\nSAR NANGE TERA SHAAM KE DARBAR ME JAANA
english translation text: O DAUGHTER OF HAIDER (A.S)! THAT MOMENT WAS LIKE THE END OF THE WORLD,\nWHEN YOU WERE TAKEN TO THE COURT OF YAZID IN THAT STATE
